purpose: 四章精英视觉设计参考；实机使用原生剪纸轮廓与动态弱点

prompts.valley: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: elite enemy concept sheet for Chinese ink/papercut roguelike 画灵. Landscape sheet, FIVE large isolated full-body designs, numbered 1-5, cream parchment, absolutely readable silhouettes, carved paper layers, inky dark green outlines, bone ivory details, muted cinnabar and antique gold. No UI. Chapter sunset haunted valley. Subjects left to right: 1 skeletal woman beneath huge red ribbed parasol, 2 hanging soul-lantern lord with antler branches and red lantern body, 3 masked marionette with red threads stretched between hands and three paper charms, 4 hunched mountain ape carrying cracked stone stele on back, 5 large dark moth matriarch with carved red/gold eyespots and exposed pale abdomen. Show bright gold breakable weakpoints on each and small attack silhouette beneath. Elegant eerie mythic folk art, game-production shape language, NOT cute blobs, NOT realistic 3D, no neon, no clutter. Detailed ornamental cutouts inside strong broad shapes. Label only numbers.
prompts.sea: Use case: stylized-concept. Production elite monster sheet for Chinese papercut ink game, landscape parchment with five numbered standalone full-body creatures, generous spacing. Chapter dream whale ocean: 1 massive reef-armored crab general with red coral epaulettes and gold claw joints; 2 long-tentacle spectral jellyfish bound in ornamental tide ropes; 3 pearl clam lady with open scalloped shell and pale pearl heart; 4 haunted hermit crab carrying broken Chinese junk ship, three small floating sailboats; 5 pair of yin-yang manta rays, ivory and deep jade, linked by slender gold tide ribbon. Strong graphic silhouettes, intricate cutpaper perforations, layered opaque teal, charcoal jade, aged ivory, tiny coral red and dullgold accents. No glowing neon, no photorealism, no 3D, no game UI. Gold weakpoints and restrained small attack examples beneath each. Beautiful elegant slightly ominous folk mythology illustration, readable enough to reproduce as game sprites. Number labels only.
prompts.palace: Use case: stylized-concept. Five elite enemy design board for Chinese paper-cut roguelike, wide parchment, 5 separate full-body numbered figures. Star palace theme: 1 celestial mirror knight with three ornate gold rotating mirrors, ivory armor and dark indigo silk; 2 star weaving maiden with two floating shuttle spindles and constellation threads; 3 upside-down bronze bell spirit with large suspended swinging clapper, ceremonial paper streamers; 4 imposing imperial seal official holding huge jade square stamp, incomplete gold ground seal; 5 crescent blade princess with three ivory curved returning blades and long indigo ribbons. Masterful broad shapes with delicate inner paper cutouts, antique brass, bone ivory, muted indigo and tiny cinnabar accents, visible glowing warm gold breakpoints. Strong distinct silhouette each, elegant mythic eerie, layered flat folk cutpaper, no realistic 3D, no blue neon, no clutter/UI. Include small attacks/weakpoints studies beneath, labels numbers only.
prompts.snow: Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape monster production concept sheet, five numbered spaced full-body designs on cream rice paper for Chinese ink/papercut action game. Snow sleeping beast chapter: 1 frost armored mountain ape with ice plates and gold cracked joints; 2 snow crone in tall pointed paper cloak carrying antique lantern with gold flame and two smaller snow lamps; 3 huge snow ape hugging a crooked pine covered with three heavy snowballs; 4 pair of frost deer, one bulky charging ivory deer and rear slender antlered healer with gold frosted antlers; 5 curled mountain bone guardian resembling a sleeping giant pangolin with angular bone plates, three warm gold awakening stones and chest core. Ink charcoal, desaturated gray-green, bone white, muted cold sage and antique warm gold, tiny rust-red. Elegant strong silhouettes with intricate layered paper carving, readable anatomy, monster rather than cute blob. Gold weakpoints plus tiny attack studies, no bright cyan/neon, no UI, no realistic 3D. Number labels only.
